versions.changelog:
- Initial release of skill-smartcaptcha for integrating and administering Yandex SmartCaptcha.
- Supports website widget integration (basic, advanced, invisible), server-side token validation via /validate, React (@yandex/smart-captcha), and mobile apps (Android/iOS/Flutter via WebView).
- Guidance and templates for creating, configuring, and managing captchas in Yandex Cloud (console, CLI, Terraform, REST/gRPC API).
- Troubleshooting steps for common issues, including widget display problems and bot bypass.
- Includes references, ready-to-use code templates, and detailed documentation for various platforms and integration scenarios.
